purpose: Scholarly sources supporting Korean nuanced-emotion admission. These sources do not replace authoritative lexical evidence or card-specific cross-language comparison evidence.

sources.title: 한국어 감정단어의 목록 작성과 차원 탐색
sources.title_en: Making a List of Korean Emotion Terms and Exploring Dimensions Underlying Them
sources.boundary: Supports inclusion of Korean emotion terms in a research inventory; does not establish that a term is uniquely Korean or untranslatable.

sources.title: 한국어 감정표현단어의 추출과 범주화
sources.title_en: Korean Emotion Vocabulary: Extraction and Categorization of Feeling Words
sources.boundary: Supports Korean feeling-word categorization; public copy still requires term-specific lexical and semantic evidence.

sources.title: 한국어교육에서 감정형용사의 제시 방안 - ‘아쉽다’, ‘안타깝다’, ‘아깝다’, ‘섭섭하다’, ‘서운하다’를 중심으로
sources.title_en: A Study on Setting up the Educational Informations of Synonyms of Emotional Adjective ‘Aswibda’ in Korean Language Education
supports: semantic/situational differentiation among near-synonymous Korean emotional adjectives
sources.boundary: Supports nuanced usage differences among near-synonyms; does not imply that other languages cannot express the same experiences.

sources.title: 한국어 감정형용사의 중국어 대응 양상 연구 - ‘아쉽다, 섭섭하다, 서운하다, 안타깝다, 아깝다’를 중심으로-
sources.title_en: Study on the Semantic Correspondence Modalities of Emotional Adjectives for Chinese Korean Learners
supports: multiple Chinese correspondence patterns rather than one fixed equivalent
sources.boundary: Directly useful for Chinese comparison; individual public comparison wording must remain source-consistent.

sources.title: 한국어교육을 위한 감정형용사 유의어 변별 연구 - ‘만족스럽다’류의 의미적·통사적·화용적 변별을 중심으로 -
sources.title_en: A Study on the Differences Between Synonymous Emotional Adjectives for Korean Language Education
supports: achievement-related semantic/pragmatic distinctiveness of 뿌듯하다 from 만족스럽다/흐뭇하다/흡족하다
sources.boundary: Supports a specific semantic/pragmatic distinction, not cultural exclusivity.

sources.title: 한국어 감동 표현 감정형용사의 유의어 교육 연구 : 유의어 변별 기제를 중심으로
sources.title_en: A Study on Korean Emotion Adjectives Expressing Being Moved: Synonym-Differentiation Mechanisms
supports: morphosyntactic, semantic and pragmatic differentiation of 감격스럽다/벅차다/뭉클하다/찡하다/뿌듯하다 using corpus and native/non-native speaker data
sources.boundary: Supports internal Korean nuance and usage distinctions; public claims require concise original synthesis.
